title: Estée Lauder accelerates turnaround and targets higher margins by 2030
summary: The Estée Lauder Companies reported a 7% increase in net sales in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, ended September 30, 2026, exceeding analysts' expectations of around 5% growth. Building on this momentum, the US cosmetics group is raising its full-year guidance and setting new growth and operating margin targets for 2030 as it continues its turnaround.
